notes: I changed the model from `max(0, 5.2-2.5x)` on `[-2,2]` to the raw line `5.2-2.5x` on `[-2.1, 2.1]` (no clipping), because E2 shows the line continues past ±2 up to ±2.1 (x=2.1 gives -0.05, x=-2.1 gives 10.45) and then drops to 0 at ±2.2 — so the support window is `[-2.1, 2.1]`, not `[-2, 2]`, and negative values are not clipped within it.
